Guide · Tooele County, Utah

Moving to Tooele County

Tooele County sits directly west of Salt Lake County, on the other side of the Oquirrh Mountains. The towns the team serves are in the Tooele Valley, between the Oquirrhs on the east and the Stansbury Mountains on the west. This guide covers the towns, the routes east, the outdoors, and the offices to contact once you arrive. It does not rank the towns; which one fits depends on what you want, and we are glad to talk it through.

Compare the townsAsk the team

The towns

Grantsville

Grantsville sits on the west side of the Tooele Valley, below the Stansbury Mountains. It is one of the older towns in the county, with a historic core along the main street and newer subdivisions spreading toward the foothills.

Stansbury Park

Stansbury Park is a planned community in the north end of the Tooele Valley, built around a man-made lake and a golf course. It sits close to the Interstate 80 corridor at the entrance to the valley.

Tooele

Tooele is the county seat and the largest city in the valley, set at the base of the Oquirrh Mountains. It has a long main street, established neighborhoods, and newer development on its outskirts.

Erda

Erda is a community between Tooele and the north end of the valley, known for open ground and mountain views on both sides of the valley.

Lake Point

Lake Point sits at the north end of the Tooele Valley near the Great Salt Lake, at the junction where the valley meets the Interstate 80 corridor.

Stockton

Stockton is a small town south of the city of Tooele, set between the Oquirrh and Stansbury ranges near Rush Valley. It has a historic mining heritage and a quiet main street.

Getting to Salt Lake County

Commute times vary with the season and the hour, so drive the route yourself at the time you would actually travel.

Interstate 80

The main route east into Salt Lake County. It runs along the north end of the Tooele Valley, where the valley meets the Great Salt Lake.

State Route 36

The valley's north-south spine. It leaves Interstate 80 at Lake Point and runs south through Stansbury Park, Erda, and Tooele to Stockton and on into Rush Valley.

State Route 138

Connects Grantsville east to State Route 36 and Interstate 80.

Midvalley Highway

A 4.5-mile road from State Route 138 to Interstate 80, opened by the Utah Department of Transportation in 2021 as a second link between the west side of the valley and the interstate.

Transit

Utah Transit Authority runs bus service between Tooele County and Salt Lake County. UTA On Demand covers rides within Tooele County; UTA lists 435-843-4114 for those rides.

Road information: Utah Department of Transportation. Transit information: Utah Transit Authority. Links are in the sources below.

Outdoors and things to do

Stansbury Lake

A man-made lake in Stansbury Park, first built in the early 1970s and covering about 110 acres. The Stansbury Service Agency publishes its rules. stansburypark.gov

The Peak Sports and Entertainment Complex

A Tooele County Parks and Recreation venue. tooelecountyparksandrec.org

Benson Grist Mill

A historic site kept by Tooele County Parks and Recreation. tooelecountyparksandrec.org

Tooele Valley Museum and Historic Park

Tooele City's museum of the valley's history. museum.tooelecity.gov

Bonneville Salt Flats

Public land managed by the Bureau of Land Management at the far west end of the county, along Interstate 80. blm.gov

Annual events

  • Tooele County Fair: Held July 30 through August 1 in 2026.
  • Tooele Arts Festival: Held June 12 through 14 in 2026.
  • Fridays on Vine: A Tooele City Arts Council series.
  • Explore Tooele: The county's visitor site, for a wider list of places and events.

Checklist: offices to contact

Which offices apply depends on the address. City limits, not the postal town, decide it.

  • Tooele County

    Property records through the Recorder (eRecording is available), records requests and voter registration through the Clerk, and planning questions for property outside city limits.

    tooeleco.gov · Recorder eRecording · Clerk records requests

  • Tooele City Recorder

    City records for addresses inside Tooele City.

    tooelecity.gov

  • Grantsville City

    City services and permits for addresses inside Grantsville.

    grantsvilleut.gov

  • Stansbury Service Agency

    The lake and parks in Stansbury Park.

    stansburypark.gov

  • Stansbury Park Improvement District

    Water service in Stansbury Park.

  • Tooele County School District

    District calendars are posted on the district site.

    District calendars

  • State of Utah

    Update your driver license and vehicle registration after the move.

  • Utilities

    Providers differ by town and by address. Ask the seller or the listing agent which providers serve the home before closing.
